title: Ɔdaesofo no Foro a Ɔforo
intro: Ɔkra bi a wɔahyɛ no sɛ ɔbɛyɛ kɛse, nanso sɔhwɛ ahorow a emu yɛ den sɔɔ no hwɛe no fii akwantu soronko bi ase. Na ahoɔyaw, ntetewmu, ne amanehunu a ɛnteɛ na ɛhyɛɛ onipa yi kwan agyirae, na ɛbaa awiei wɔ gyinabea a asɛyɛde kɛse ne nkabom a emu dɔ wom mu. So wubetumi ahu saa onipa nwonwaso yi afi Kur’aan mu?
clues: Bere bi na wɔn a wɔbɛn me paa no ani bere me, na ɛmaa me ne m’awofo ne me fie ntam tetew kɛse.
Mihyiaa bere bi a na ɛyɛ den kɛse, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ akwantufo tɔn me bo ketewaa bi.
Wɔbɔɔ me sobo wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnteɛ so sɛ mayɛ bɔne na midii mfe pii wɔ afiase, nanso me gyidi kɔɔ so anhinhim.
Wɔmaa me tumi soronko a mede bɛkyerɛ anisoadehu ahorow a emu yɛ den ase, na ɛno yɛɛ adwinnade wɔ m’akwan a ɛkɔ ahofadi mu no mu.
Awiei koraa no, me nyansa ne me mudi mu kura ma minyaa dibea a ɛwɔ tumi kɛse ne ahotoso wɔ ananafo asase so.
Ɛdenam nsɛm a esisii toatoa so so no, me ne m’awofo a ne mfe akɔ anim ne me nuanom san hyiae bere a na menni hɔ bere tenten na ɛyɛɛ yaw no.

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِأَبِيهِ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى رَأَيْتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَبًۭا وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ رَأَيْتُهُمْ لِى سَـٰجِدِينَ
verse: [Of these stories mention] when Joseph said to his father, "O my father, indeed I have seen [in a dream] eleven stars and the sun and the moon; I saw them prostrating to me." (12:4)
